js-path-mapset-1.wrong-punctuation: function countWords(text,stopWords){const stop=new Set(stopWords),out=new Map();for(const word of text.toLowerCase().match(/\w+/g)||[]){if(!stop.has(word))out.set(word,(out.get(word)||0)+1);}return out;}
js-path-mapset-1.wrong-ascii-case: function countWords(text,stopWords){const stop=new Set(stopWords),out=new Map();for(const word of text.replace(/[A-Z]/g,x=>x.toLowerCase()).split(/\s+/)){if(word&&!stop.has(word))out.set(word,(out.get(word)||0)+1);}return out;}
